programs.title: The Block
programs.desc: (PG) It's the twentieth season of The Block. Meet the five competitive couples who arrive on Phillip Island ready to renovate five houses in an old holiday resort.

programs.title: The Block
programs.desc: (PG) The Blockheads get straight down to business building the main bathroom in a battle to win prizes valued at $140,000. One contestant leaves The Block for a special reason.

programs.title: The Block
programs.desc: Couples compete to renovate properties under strict deadlines and budgets in a high-stakes reality contest. They design, build, and style spaces while facing challenges, judging, and intense competition each week. Their finished homes are auctioned, with profits determining the winners in a dramatic finale.
